verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Oneleet monitors stacks for gaps ("Hundreds of monitors watch your stack for gaps in real time") and turns scan results into in-platform findings. However, nothing documents routing control failures or drift alerts to Slack, email, or a ticketing system. The status-page email notifications cover Oneleet's own service incidents, not customer control failures, so they don't count toward this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding
